items.note: Full-width yellow band with ink rule, regular-weight 'Shop all goods' title, intro line and pill filters with 'All' selected (raised fill, ink border), over a dense 4-column grid of outlined cards. Each card has a distinct flat sticker product on a band-color square, a small category label, a title and a pink price tag, the way the reference sets out its marketplace wall. Ink current-page 'Shop' pill in the header in all three samples.

The header wraps to logo plus ink Cart button, then a Shop/Cart pill row. The band collapses to title, intro and a pill strip that runs off the right edge, which is how the spec makes it scroll. In-stock checkbox and sort select stack above a one-column card list with large sticker squares that vary color and object, and the pink price tags are readable.

Black ground with the same yellow band and ink text. Cards turn dark-raised with paper text, and the header's current-page pill and Cart button are paper-filled as the dark mapping asks. Sticker squares keep their band fills. Sample 3 draws some objects in the dark raised fill (tote, tee, mug), which the illustration palette allows.

One-column dark card list under the collapsed yellow band, with the 'All' pill ink-filled on the band and a horizontally scrolling filter strip. Paper-filled Cart button in the header. Pink price tags and band-color sticker squares stay vivid and nothing is clipped or overlapping.

Yellow detail band with the product title (breadcrumb inside or just above it) and a two-column layout: a big framed band-color square with a tilted bag sticker on the left; on the right a pink price tag, description, outline-on-demand color pills with the selected one outlined, a quantity stepper, a small pink 'Add to cart' and a Details list ruled with hairlines. The header's Shop link loses its current-page ink pill here in all samples.

Stacked: header, breadcrumb, collapsed yellow band with the title, full-width framed sticker square, pink price, description, color pills, stepper, pink Add to cart, then the Details list under an ink rule. Spacing is even and the tap targets are full size. The Shop nav link is plain text, not the ink current pill.

Dark ground with the yellow band and ink title. The selected color pill becomes a raised dark fill with a border, the stepper's middle field is dark-raised, and Add to cart stays the only pink action next to the pink price tag. The sticker square keeps its band color. The header shows no current-section pill.

Dark one-column detail: paper-filled Cart button, yellow band with the title, framed sticker, pink price, selected 'Natural' pill raised dark, outlined stepper and pink Add to cart, then hairline-ruled details. Everything is readable and in order, but the Shop nav link isn't marked current.

Same detail layout as the tote, with a different band-color square and sweater sticker in each sample, and S/M/L/XL size pills with S selected (round, ink border). Sample 3's sweater sticker is drawn small in its 250px square, but the layout holds. The Shop nav pill isn't shown as current.

Collapsed yellow band with the 'Apparel' eyebrow or breadcrumb, a framed sweater sticker on yellow or periwinkle, pink price, size pills, stepper and pink Add to cart, then the Details list. The rhythm is even. The header's Shop link is plain text.

Dark detail page: yellow band with ink title, sticker square on yellow or periwinkle, dark-raised selected size pill, pink price and one pink Add to cart, and details ruled in dark hairlines. It matches the tote page's structure. The current section isn't marked in the header.

Dark stacked detail with the collapsed band, a large sticker square, pink price tag, raised dark 'S' pill, outlined stepper, pink Add to cart and hairline details. Nothing is cut off. Same unmarked Shop nav link as the other product pages.

Empty cart: a periwinkle (samples 1-2) or teal (sample 3) band titled 'Your cart' with the free-shipping line, then a centered sticker (open box, or a pink coin with an extruded yellow rim), 'Your cart is empty', one hint sentence and one pink 'Continue shopping' button. This follows the empty-state recipe. The header's Cart link is the ink current pill.

Collapsed band with the title and shipping line, then a centered sticker, heading, sentence and one pink Continue shopping button. Sample 2 puts it in an outlined raised card with a full-width button. The Cart pill is ink-filled in the header row.

Black ground under the band-colored header. The empty-state sticker keeps its pink and yellow fills with a paper outline (currentColor), and there is one pink Continue shopping button. Sample 2's container is dark-raised with a border. The Cart current pill is paper-filled.

Dark mobile empty cart: paper-filled Cart pill and Cart button in the header, band with title and shipping line, a centered coin or box sticker with paper outline, white heading, gray sentence and one pink full-size action. Nothing overlaps and the text is readable.

findings.summary: On product detail pages the header nav doesn't mark the section the page belongs to. 'Shop' is the ink current-page pill on the listing, but it goes back to plain text on its child product pages, even though the breadcrumb starts with Shop. The spec ties the ink pill only to 'the current page', which leaves child pages unaddressed.
